description:
Two or three coins side by side, every check at once: for each, how often a buy fell 30% or more before the window was out and where the middle one ended, how often a leveraged month ended with nothing, whether spreading the entry won, how often a stop-loss sold a buy that ended in profit, and how much it moves with bitcoin. Nothing is ranked and no coin is called better. Spot and perpetual tapes, fees charged.

Use when two or three coins are being compared or chosen between. For one coin or one question the specific check gives more detail: drawdown_check, leverage_survival, averaging_in_check, stop_loss_check, diversification_check.

inputSchema.description: The coins, and optionally the window and the leverage.

coins.description: Two or three tickers, comma-separated: BTC,ETH,SOL. Kept in the order sent.

name: coin_comparison

outputSchema.description: One row per coin, in the order sent.

ok.description: false when we do not hold that data. Never a zero standing in for an answer.

reason.description: Why, in one sentence, and what we do have instead.

rows.description: Per coin: the drawdown, leverage, averaging-in and stop-loss answers, and its correlation with bitcoin (null for bitcoin itself).

source.description: The public files these numbers come from.

title: Coin comparison
